class.name: VFXGraphInstance3D
class.brief_description: Plays a [VFXGraphAsset] with a native CPU simulation (optional GPU compute update) and MultiMesh billboard rendering.
class.description: [VFXGraphInstance3D] simulates every emitter of its [member asset] in this node's local space and draws each emitter as one MultiMesh of billboard quads submitted directly to the [RenderingServer]. Particle state is stored as structure-of-arrays and all spawn and update modules, collision and death event routing between emitters, and per-module timing run natively. [codeblock] var fx := VFXGraphInstance3D.new() fx.asset = VFXGraphAsset.create_from_dictionary(VFXPresets.lightning_sparks(3)) fx.one_shot = true fx.budget_category = "combat" add_child(fx) fx.global_position = hit_position [/codeblock] The simulation is deterministic for a given [member random_seed] and step sequence. With [member use_gpu] enabled the update, integration and plane stages of every emitter run in a generated compute shader on a shared local [RenderingDevice]; spawn stages and death routing stay on the CPU. When no compute device exists (headless, dummy or Compatibility renderer) or compilation fails, the identical algorithm runs on the CPU. Because the GPU kernel uses an analytic "lite" curl noise, [code]curl_noise[/code] emitters switch to that curl as soon as [member use_gpu] is set, on CPU fallback too, so both paths match. If [member budget_category] is not empty, the effect asks the [VFXBudgetServer] singleton for admission using the sum of its emitter capacities. A rejected effect never starts ([signal rejected]); an evicted effect stops and finishes. The node frees itself after [signal finished] when [member one_shot] is enabled.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: Returns a copy of one attribute of the live particles of [param emitter]: [code]"position"[/code] and [code]"velocity"[/code] ([PackedVector3Array]), [code]"color"[/code] ([PackedColorArray]), [code]"size"[/code], [code]"age"[/code], [code]"lifetime"[/code] or a custom attribute name ([PackedFloat32Array]). Returns [code]null[/code] for unknown names.

method.name: get_budget_id
method.description: Returns the id granted by [VFXBudgetServer], or 0 if no budget slot is held.

method.name: get_emitter_names
method.description: Returns the names of the emitters of the running simulation.

method.name: get_emitter_particle_count
method.description: Returns the number of live particles of [param emitter].

method.name: get_gpu_path
method.description: Returns [code]"gpu"[/code] if the last update ran on the compute device, [code]"cpu"[/code] if it ran or fell back to the CPU, and [code]"none"[/code] if no update has run yet.

method.name: get_particle_count
method.description: Returns the number of live particles across all emitters.

method.name: get_profile
method.description: Returns accumulated microseconds per module, keyed [code]"<emitter>/<stage>/<index>:<type>"[/code], for example [code]"sparks/update/0:gravity"[/code]. GPU updates are accounted under [code]"<emitter>/gpu_kernel"[/code].

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once every emitter has finished emitting and no particles remain.

method.name: is_gpu_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the last update ran on the compute device.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the simulation is running.

method.name: play
method.description: Validates the asset, rebuilds the simulation from [member random_seed], requests budget and starts playing. Returns [code]false[/code] if there is no asset, the graph is invalid or the budget server rejected the effect.

method.name: restart
method.description: Alias of [method play]: discards the current state and starts over.

method.name: setup
method.description: Wraps [param graph] into a [VFXGraphAsset], assigns [param seed] to [member random_seed] and calls [method play].

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param delta] seconds and refreshes the MultiMeshes. Called automatically every frame while playing; call it manually for deterministic stepping.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the effect, frees all particles and render resources and releases the budget slot.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], [method play] is called when the node enters the tree at runtime (never in the editor).
Category used to request admission from [VFXBudgetServer]. If empty, the effect is not budgeted.
Maximum number of live particles across all emitters of this node. [code]-1[/code] means unlimited.
Priority used for [VFXBudgetServer] admission and eviction. Higher values are kept longer.
If [code]true[/code], the node frees itself once the effect finished.
Seed of the deterministic random generators of all emitters.
Multiplier applied to the process delta.
If [code]true[/code], the update stage runs in a generated compute shader when a compute capable [RenderingDevice] is available. See the class description for details.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when all emitters finished and no particles remain, or when the effect was evicted by [VFXBudgetServer].

signal.name: rejected
signal.description: Emitted when [VFXBudgetServer] did not admit the effect in [method play].
